## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment Product
where: ReportService (uses), src/business/reportService.ts, component business
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
const name = this.products.findById(t.productId)?.name ?? t.productId;
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B

response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the Treatment Product, the product catalogue item (for example a varroa medication). It is looked up with `this.products.findById(t.productId)?.name`, which goes through ProductRepository. B is the Treatment, the event of applying a treatment to a hive. TreatmentRepository stores these as `TreatmentRecord[]`, and ReportService fetches them with `TreatmentRepository.findByHive`. A treatment record points to a product through its `productId` field, so the two are linked entities, not one concept under two names. They are also handled by separate repositories, ProductRepository and TreatmentRepository.
